notes: Shinies: the app now knows which species have a shiny released in Pokémon GO (Serebii's list, 1,193 forms) and never marks one that has none. Each species is told by its own hue, by the game's sparkle badge beside the name (Garchomp, Slowpoke, Gengar, Pikachu), or cannot be shiny yet; My Log says so.
